title: Measuring Digital Labour Market Transitions with a Digital Semantic Score: An AI-Based Methodology Applied to the Dutch Labour Market
abstract: arXiv:2608.24222v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The digital transformation of the Dutch labour market is reshaping occupational language, career pathways, and job-related skills. Addressing these changes requires granular labour market intelligence. This paper develops an AI-based methodology to analyse digitalisation using data covering millions of Dutch job profiles. The methodology combines embedding-based similarity search and large language model classification to map unstructured job information to harmonised ESCO occupations. We also introduce a Digital Semantic Score that measures how strongly job titles and skills are associated with digital concepts relative to a non-digital reference. Using embeddings and cosine similarity to transparent digital and non-digital anchor groups, this indicator moves beyond keyword-based approaches by capturing broader digital meanings in occupational language and worker skill profiles. It enables analysis across occupations, career transit

translated_title: 用数字语义分数衡量数字劳动力市场转型：一种应用于荷兰劳动力市场的基于人工智能的方法论
translated_abstract: 荷兰劳动力市场的数字化转型正在重塑职业语言、职业发展路径以及工作相关技能。应对这些变化需要精细化的劳动力市场情报。本文开发了一种基于人工智能的方法论，利用涵盖数百万荷兰职位档案的数据来分析数字化进程。该方法结合了基于嵌入的相似性搜索和大语言模型分类，将非结构化的职位信息映射到统一的ESCO职业体系中。我们还引入了“数字语义分数”，用于衡量职位名称和技能相对于非数字参考而言与数字概念的关联强度。该指标通过嵌入向量和余弦相似度与透明的数字及非数字锚定组进行比较，超越了基于关键词的方法，能够捕捉职业语言和劳动者技能档案中更广泛的数字含义。它支持跨职业、职业转换等方面的分析。
tldr: 本文提出一种结合嵌入相似性搜索与大语言模型分类的AI方法论，并创新性地引入“数字语义分数”来量化职业与数字概念的语义关联程度，从而更全面地衡量荷兰劳动力市场的数字化转型。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an AI-based methodology combining embedding-based similarity search and LLM classification, and introduces a novel "Digital Semantic Score" that quantifies the semantic association of job titles and skills with digital concepts, enabling more comprehensive measurement of digital labour market transitions in the Netherlands.
